name: Render
long_description:
Render is an AI CMO that runs a company's entire marketing. Owners set a budget, and Render does the rest.

We're at $1.7M ARR, growing 100% month over month, with 1,000+ paying businesses.

Owners tell Render what they sell and set a budget. Render decides where to advertise, makes the ads, and keeps moving the money to whatever brings in customers, across Meta, Google, YouTube ads, direct mail, TV, etc. Most businesses can't afford a marketing team, and agencies charge thousands a month to run just one or two channels. Render runs all of them for a fraction of the price.
one_liner: AI CMO that puts marketing on autopilot
